marketVenues.name: Carleton Place Farmers' Market
marketVenues.location: 11 Beckwith Street, Carleton Place, Ontario, K7C 0R1
marketVenues.schedule: Saturdays from 8:30 AM to 12:30 PM during market season
marketVenues.notes: Follow us on Instagram and Facebook for weekly menu updates, free samples, and weather-related changes.

items.name: Authentic Masala Chai
items.description: Warm brewed chai with milk and traditional spices.
items.recipeNote: Serve hot. Sweeten to taste when requested.

items.name: Chai Concentrate Bottles
items.description: Take-home brewed concentrate. Add milk and sweetener to taste. Available in two sizes 500ml and 1 litre bottles.
items.dietary: No milk or sugar added unless noted
items.recipeNote: Keep refrigerated. Mix with milk and sweetener of choice.

items.name: Traditional Rice Pudding
items.description: Creamy rice pudding delicately infused with cardamom, saffron, and warm aromatic spices.
items.recipeNote: Serve chilled or gently warmed. Garnish before serving.

items.name: Quinoa Chia Pudding
items.description: Plant-based, creamy quinoa and chia pudding with a gentle nutty bite, lightly sweetened and warmly spiced for a comforting, satisfying spoonful.
items.recipeNote: Keep chilled. Add toppings close to serving time.

items.name: Mango Lassi pudding
items.description: Creamy mango lassi pudding with luscious mango, tangy yogurt, and a fragrant touch of cardamom. Perfect Breakfast pudding with Chia, coconut, yogurt, saffron, mango puree, and pistachios. Our market favorite.

items.name: NYC Style Chocolate Chip walnut cookie
items.description: Thick, bakery-style chocolate chip cookie with crisp golden edges, a soft gooey centre, and rich pools of chocolate. Perfect for all day snacking.

items.name: Maple Almond Croissant Cookie
items.description: Made with Almond flour and toasted almonds, core filled with dairy free chocolate, flourless.
items.recipeNote: Healthy and delicious treat with a hint of indulgence.

items.name: Wholesome Breakfast Cookie
items.description: Delicious Breakfast cookie made with gluten-free oats, Raisins, nut butter, sunflower seeds, cashews and aromatic spices.
items.recipeNote: Great as a breakfast-style market item.

items.name: Cashew Red Velvet Cookie
items.description: A rich, soft-baked red velvet cookie with a subtle cocoa flavour, studded with creamy cashews and dairy-free chocolate chips. Decadent, slightly nutty, and perfectly balanced for a luxurious bite.

items.name: Pistachio Rose Cardamom Cookie
items.description: Fragrant, buttery cookie infused with warm cardamom, delicately scented with rose, and finished with crunchy pistachios for an elegant, nutty bite.
ingredients: Gluten Free Flour Blend (rice flour, potato starch, tapioca starch, whole sorghum flour, whole brown rice flour, whole quinoa flour, xanthan gum), Light Brown Sugar, Pistachio, Edible Rose Petals, Plant-Based Butter, Granulated Cane Sugar, Organic Flax Seeds, Unsweetened Organic Soy Milk, Cornstarch, Pure Vanilla Extract, Cardamom, Baking Powder, Baking Soda, Sea Salt

items.name: Zucchini Brownie
items.description: Fudgy brownie made with zucchini and cocoa. Perfect gluten-free treat for chocolate lovers.
items.recipeNote: A yummy chocolate delight with hidden veggies for a healthier treat.

items.name: Orange Cranberry Cardamom Cupcake
ingredients: Gluten-free all-purpose flour, unsweetened soy milk, granulated sugar, dried cranberries, neutral vegetable oil, plant-based butter, cornstarch, fresh orange juice, orange zest, pure vanilla extract, apple cider vinegar, cardamom, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
items.description: A soft, fragrant cupcake bursting with bright orange, tart cranberries, and warm aromatic cardamom for a perfectly balanced, refreshing bite.

items.name: Pumpkin Chai Spice Cupcake
ingredients: Gluten-free flour blend, pumpkin purée, brown sugar, pure maple syrup, vegetable oil, vanilla extract, pumpkin spice, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and sea salt. Streusel: Gluten-free flour blend, plant-based butter, cane sugar, pumpkin spice, and orange zest
items.description: A cozy pumpkin cupcake infused with warming chai-inspired spices and topped with a buttery spiced streusel — soft, aromatic, and full of fall flavour.

items.name: Matcha Bliss Balls
items.description: Delicately sweet with earthy matcha notes, these energizing bites offer a smooth, balanced flavor and a gentle boost from antioxidant-rich green tea.
items.recipeNote: A naturally energizing snack featuring premium matcha and wholesome ingredients for a clean, satisfying bite.

items.name: Protein Power Balls
items.description: Packed with plant-based protein and naturally sweet dates, these satisfying bites are designed to fuel busy days, workouts, and afternoon cravings.
items.recipeNote: A protein-rich energy bite inspired by traditional flavors and crafted for lasting satisfaction.

items.name: Snike Balls
items.description: Inspired by a classic chocolate-peanut combination, these rich bites combine dates, peanut butter, pistachios, and dark chocolate for an indulgent yet wholesome treat.
items.recipeNote: Our wholesome take on a beloved chocolate-caramel flavor profile, made with real ingredients and naturally sweetened dates.
